description: Texas active franchise taxpayers (Comptroller open data, data.texas.gov): searches by taxpayer name and returns SOS file number, charter date, status code, organisation type and address. Public open data; not a live SOS filing search and no officer data. Related tools on this server, for a different need: b2b_chicago_business_licenses when you need City of Chicago current active business licenses: searches; b2b_ny_business_entity when you need New York Department of State active corporations: searches. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Taxpayer name part, letters, digits, spaces and . , & - only, 2 to 60 characters
